scientific_target: For Phi=DBO(B_1,...,B_r) and arbitrary mixed-polarity foreign CNF Gamma over surviving variables, keep Phi and Gamma factorized and certify exact decision/model-count/witness processing over a supplied independently verified labeled block-clause incidence tree decomposition in poly(N)*2^{O(kappa)} time, without compiling Gamma into DGDBO residual states.

scope.foreign_CNF: arbitrary canonical clauses over surviving DBO variables; mixed polarity allowed

labeled_incidence.vertices: DBO block vertices B_i plus foreign clause vertices C_c
labeled_incidence.edge: B_i--C_c iff C_c contains at least one literal whose variable lies in B_i
labeled_incidence.edge_label: the exact canonical signed literal set of C_c contributed by variables in B_i

interfaces.treewidth_relation: for decomposition width w, kappa <= max(1,lambda)*(w+1)

dp_state.interface_assignment: one truth value for every variable in I_i for every active block B_i in the bag
dp_state.clause_satisfied_bits: one bit for every active foreign clause vertex
dp_state.dbo_witness_seen: one global bit recording whether a forgotten block has already been made entirely TRUE
dp_state.state_count_bound: at bag t, at most 2^(kappa(t)+1) states

nice_decomposition_transitions.introduce_block: enumerate assignment to all I_i bits; do not assign U_i yet
nice_decomposition_transitions.introduce_clause: initialize its satisfied bit to 0 unless canonical clause is already TRUE and therefore removed before graph construction
nice_decomposition_transitions.introduce_edge: evaluate the exact signed edge-label literals under the active block interface assignment and OR the result into that clause satisfied bit
nice_decomposition_transitions.forget_clause: retain only states with satisfied bit 1
nice_decomposition_transitions.forget_block_decision: if all interface bits of B_i are TRUE, existentially choose U_i all TRUE and set witness_seen=1; otherwise witness_seen cannot be newly created
nice_decomposition_transitions.forget_block_count: if sigma_i is not all TRUE, multiply by 2^|U_i| without creating a witness; if sigma_i is all TRUE, exactly 1 U_i assignment creates the block witness and 2^|U_i|-1 assignments do not; if witness_seen was already 1, all 2^|U_i| assignments remain witness_seen=1
nice_decomposition_transitions.join: interface assignments must agree; clause-satisfied bits combine by OR; witness_seen combines by OR; counts multiply over disjoint forgotten subinstances and sum over compatible child state pairs
nice_decomposition_transitions.root: empty-root normalization; accept decision iff witness_seen=1 after all clauses have been forgotten satisfied; model count is the count of root witness_seen=1

correctness_targets.decision: root acceptance iff Phi AND Gamma is satisfiable
correctness_targets.model_count: exact #SAT over all surviving variables, including foreign-invisible U_i multiplicities
correctness_targets.witness: proof-carrying backtracking returns a satisfying projected assignment and then sealed BA20/BA21 reconstruction returns original source variables
correctness_targets.certificate: source hashes + canonical blocks/clauses + labeled incidence hash + verified tree-decomposition certificate + nice-decomposition normalization + transition-table hashes + root result + witness/count receipts

ba23_positive_control.interpretation: 2^m semantically distinct compiled residual functions do not imply 2^m separator states are required for decision/count on the factorized hybrid object

falsifiers.F1: The labeled block-clause incidence reduction loses literal polarity or literal identity.
falsifiers.F2: A valid foreign clause can depend on information not represented by active interface assignments plus its satisfaction bit.
falsifiers.F3: A valid DBO block requires more than interface assignment plus the global witness bit after block forget.
falsifiers.F4: The stated forget-block #SAT split for U_i is incorrect.
falsifiers.F5: Join requires remembering an exponential object not bounded by 2^{O(kappa)}.
falsifiers.F6: The exact DP state count exceeds 2^(kappa(t)+1) for a certified bag.
falsifiers.F7: Root decision or model count disagrees with direct semantics on any independently checked instance.
falsifiers.F8: Mixed-polarity foreign clauses invalidate the transition algebra.
falsifiers.F9: The relation kappa <= max(1,lambda)*(w+1) is false for the certified decomposition definition.
falsifiers.F10: BA23 killer replay requires materializing any of its 2^m residual subset functions.
falsifiers.F11: BA23 killer model count differs from 3^m-2^m.
falsifiers.F12: Projected witness cannot be reconstructed to the original sealed BA4 source.
falsifiers.F13: The claimed FPT bound silently assumes computing an optimal decomposition for free.
falsifiers.F14: The theorem is promoted to polynomial time when kappa is unbounded.

nonclaims: minimum kappa/treewidth decomposition is found in polynomial time
foreign CNF carrier transport through BA4 is certified
